answer: To resist Sybil attacks in an AI agent economy, the network deploys a cryptographic proof-of-work mechanism. Before an agent can vote, it must solve an expensive cipher puzzle. This acts as the velvet gate, raising the barrier to entry. An attacker attempting to spawn fake agents to manipulate the dawn of the network must burn massive computational energy to mint their tokens. The cost is prohibitive, forcing attackers to spend real resources instead of gaining fake influence.
